resources.string: My beloved Lilith, how could you leave me so soon?
The world is darker without your shining presence beside me.
I vow we shall be reunited, no matter how long it takes.
There is a way to bring you back, my love.
An ancient power called the Tear of Gaea.
Why did you not tell me of this? Soon, you shall be reunited at my side!
The Tear can only be opened with the blood of an Amarah.
I shall not spill yours, you are far too precious.
But we have another source… our daughter. How fortunate we are to have her…
If you want her so badly, I'll send you to her myself!
NO! How …?
Lilith! What are you doing?
Mother!!
Always remember, Cecilia – you are my daughter.
Lilith, my love!
I’ve come to return you to my side where you belong!
So that we may rule together for eternity!
You… are not my Alecksi. What has become of you?
I look into your eyes, and all I see is darkness.
This is your doing, Soulwarden!
You have turned my daughter against me, and now - my own wife!
Gasp! No…
I'm sorry...
Alecksi… My mind…
AAAAAHHHHHH!

I’ll tell you this for free: look for hidden levers. Not all dead ends are what they seem.
"I'm trying to find the cellar."
Thank you for freeing me. I'm sorry about before; I feel like we didn't start off on the right foot.
Thank you for freeing me. I'm sorry about before; I feel like we didn't start off on the right foot.
I was overwhelmed, but am otherwise unharmed. I was also sent to retrieve the Tear of Gaea.
"Did you see the Tear?"
Asena guards it below. If you're serious about reclaiming it, you'll need to move quickly. The wolfmother has many dens.

resources.string: Imagine meeting you here! We keep running into each other at the worst places.
I do not know Morgaine's intentions, but I do know that my father will not rest until he finds the Tear.
Leave my father to me. For now, return to the castle and wait for my word.
You said Morgaine has been ill. Has she been fatigued? Sensitive to light, perhaps? I wonder…
This isn't my first trip to the dungeon, sad to say. I know this place like the back of my hand. I'll meet you at the reliquary.
My father is not himself! When I asked him about Morgaine, he accused me of trying to steal the Tear -- and you can imagine what happened next.
Exactly. I'm not sure what is going on, but if we want to find out, we need to visit my father’s private reliquary.
He often spends time there, contemplating the past. If there are clues waiting to be found, I would search there first.
"What about you?"
This isn't my first trip to the dungeon, sad to say. I know this place like the back of my hand. I'll meet you at the reliquary.
"You ended up in here."
Meet me outside at the Corvus Bridge.
He thinks the Tear can bring my mother back? I don't even remember what she's like, other than the vague sense of comfort I feel at the sound of her name.
I suspect she didn't realize why he wanted the Tear. Which means he probably lied to her about the Upyr as well.
It's too dangerous to speak of this here. These walls have eyes -- and ears. We should split up to avoid detection.
Meet me outside at the Corvus Bridge.
"Did Morgaine know the truth?"
We need to find Morgaine and question her about the Tear… and my father.
It's clear that my father is up to something, but whatever it is, he doesn't trust us to know. He's always been secretive, but... this feels different.
Have you found where Morgaine is being held yet? We can't waste any more time.
We must be close if the Upyr are so desperate to throw us off course. This is more than a game to them… they are following orders.
We need to reach Morgaine before she finishes her transformation!
But why is Morgaine's transformation so important to them? Truly, what purpose does it serve? There is no shortage of Thralls in Nighthaven.
We need to reach Morgaine before she finishes her transformation!
We must hurry! The Enthrallment may already have taken hold.
Hope won't reach her in time... We'll need luck if we're going to climb this tower before she transforms!
"Don't give up hope."
Go! You must make it to the Grand Carnival before my father realizes what we have done.
I'm sorry, but I do not know how to reverse the Enthrallment. Once it begins -- there is no turning back.
I've been thinking, if we want to know more about my father's plans, we could search the lost Archive. It was once the repository of all Upyr knowledge.
I've been thinking, if we want to know more about my father's plans, we could search the lost Archive. It was once the repository of all Upyr knowledge.
No. I supposedly visited it when I was a child, but I have no memory of the place. I was hoping you could ask the Fortune Mother.
"Do you know where it is?"
These ruins are like icebergs -- much more lurks beneath the surface than what the eye can see. Be on your guard.
Have you learned of a way into the lost Archive? My search brought me here, though I have yet to find anything useful.
Then perhaps I am on the right path after all. The key to the Archive must be here somewhere.
These ruins are like icebergs -- much more lurks beneath the surface than what the eye can see. Be on your guard.
"The Fortune Mother said to start here."
I've discovered my father's plan. He's going to use his power to enter Lilith's dreams. If we have any hope to stop him, we'll need to get there first.
I've discovered my father's plan. He's going to use his power to enter Lilith's dreams. If we have any hope to stop him, we'll need to get there first.
Yes. My mother's notes mentioned an artifact, hidden in the in the inner sanctum of the Archive, that grants the gift of dreamwalking. But we'll need a way in.
"And the Archive has a way?"
We must reach Lilith before my father!
My father is planning to use the Tear of Gaea to revive Lilith… my mother. But doing so will have dangerous consequences for the rest of Aeternum.
You're right. We can do this. It's time to test the power of this Amulet of Ninsun for ourselves.
This chamber is the eternal resting place of Lilith -- my mother. Strange… I have no memories of her.
It doesn't bother me much. How can I feel the loss of someone I cannot remember. All that remains are impressions -- warmth, love? My imagination perhaps.
"We've come this far together."
You're right. We can do this. It's time to test the power of this Amulet of Ninsun for ourselves.
We have to confront my father within Lilith’s dreams, before he can use the Tear of Gaea to return her to life -- and destroy Aeternum in exchange.
"I'm sorry you didn't know her."
I must think on what I will do next. Go on ahead. I will meet you in the chapel.
We did it. We stopped him, but... He still managed to use the Tear.
Thank you. It was not easy to stand against my father, but I see now he was willing to trade the entire world for one person.
Thank you. It was not easy to stand against my father, but I see now he was willing to trade the entire world for one person.

Have the Berlaur gone? I merely wanted supplies to restock my camp when the town was attacked!

We meet again! I really appreciated your help in Grivaros. Who could have predicted the Berlaur would choose then to attack?
We meet again! I really appreciated your help in Grivaros. Who could have predicted the Berlaur would choose then to attack?

Fortune Mother does not grant her gifts to just anyone. You must be a rare soul indeed to receive such a blessing.

You will always be welcome here, friend! May your eyes always see the truth, even when it is hidden from view.

string.direction: Overly proud, trying too hard.
string.context: The players will hear this if they managed to make it into the zone before they can do any of the quests.
string.speaker: Lord Galbrion
string.name: LordGalbrion

resources.string: I am Lord Galbrion, head of House Galbrion, and you would be wise to make a friend of me.

string.direction: Oozing charm laced with insincerity
string.context: Galbrion is a social climber with low social status, and wants to cozy up to the player because Alecksi trusts them.
string.speaker: Lord Galbrion
string.name: LordGalbrion

resources.string: Welcome to the ball! Anyone invited by Alecksi is a friend of mine. Ask anything of me and I will provide it.

string.direction: Wry, Jeeves type, has seen too much.
string.context: The players will hear this if they managed to make it into the zone before they can do any of the quests.
string.speaker: Volos Dragomir
string.name: VolosDragomir

resources.string: Welcome to House Dracul. May your stay here be... enlightening.
Ah, you must be the person Alecksi mentioned to me earlier. You are here to fetch the wine, yes?
The cellar is not far from here, but you know how these old places are. I hope you are as spry as you look!
You have to go up a flight of stairs, over, up another flight, and another to the chapel before you can go down, through a courtyard, and down again.
"Yes. Where is the cellar located?"

string.direction: Catty, definitely snobbish
string.context: Dislikes how hard Galbrion is trying
string.speaker: Volos Dragomir
string.name: VolosDragomir

resources.string: Did you know Galbrion, that upstart Governor is here? I'm surprised such a minor house was invited to the ball.

string.direction: Overly earnest, puffed up with pride for the Archives
string.context: The players will hear this if they managed to make it into the zone before they can do any of the quests.
string.speaker: Lord Varlaam
string.name: LordVarlaam

resources.string: Have you visited the new Archives? They are certainly impressive. I would know, as I endeavor to have the most complete collection in the land.

string.context: Loves to go into detail about lore minutae
string.speaker: Lord Varlaam
string.name: LordVarlaam

resources.string: I can't help you with the Berlaur, I'm not sure what motivates such creatures. Though the tales we have about the Tear of Gaea are truly fascinating.
A bit of everything... Oh, you mean about the Tear of Gaea? It’s a powerful artifact, thrumming with the concentrated life force of the world!
I can understand why it's so coveted! Just think of what you could do with all that raw power!
"What do you know?"

string.direction: Like a fighter bro at a bar
string.context: The players will hear this if they managed to make it into the zone before they can do any of the quests.
string.speaker: Lord Bathory
string.name: LordBathory

resources.string: You there, you look like you've seen a fight or two. Let us swap tales! The gorier the better!

string.direction: Excited, finally there is something worth doing at the ball
string.context: Would love to talk the player's ear off about tactics and combat.
string.speaker: Lord Bathory
string.name: LordBathory

resources.string: This party is boring me to death, and I could do with a little excitement. I hear you've skirmished with the Berlaur, how do you find their tactics?

string.direction: Dismissive. If you haven't heard of her, you aren't worth her time.
string.context: The players will hear this if they managed to make it into the zone before they can do any of the quests.
string.speaker: Lady Carmilla
string.name: LadyCarmilla

resources.string: Did you hear the story of how I stole Lord Bathory's favorite sword? No? A pity. You'll just have to guess what happens, then.

string.direction: Aristocratic, fully aware of her position of power over the player
string.context: This is somewhat ironic, as she's a spy and is calling out the player on overhearing her words.
string.speaker: Lady Carmilla
string.name: LadyCarmilla

resources.string: Then I shoved the stiletto in up to the hilt and... Oh! Didn't see you there. Don't you know it is rude to listen in on other people's conversations?
The King sure does have a loose tongue. But yes, I pride myself on having a good ear for what is going on.
"Wait… Alecksi is the King?"
Oh, did he not mention that? Typical. Well, you'll find those filthy beasts to the northeast, particularly in the forest around Tularest.
"Alecksi says you may collect rumors."

string.context: The players will hear this if they managed to make it into the zone before they can do any of the quests.
string.speaker: Oprea
string.name: Oprea

resources.string: If you can believe it, this used to be a nice town.
Have you seen what those brutes did to our poor town? This place used to be beautiful. The streetlights were one of a kind. You don't get that quality just anywhere.
Of course they are! They just charged on through, with no thought to anyone or anything. I'm still shocked that the shields failed. They never fail.
Would you mind making my home a bit more secure? Just in case the shield doesn't come back up and those beasts return to do more damage.
"Things are a bit smashed."
I'm not going anywhere. This is my home, or what's left of it. I'm too old to pick up and start again somewhere else.

string.context: The players will hear this if they managed to make it into the zone before they can do any of the quests.
string.speaker: Lepadat
string.name: Lepadat

resources.string: And to think we saved for so long to buy a home here…

string.direction: Not quite angry, more incredulous.
string.speaker: Lepadat
string.name: Lepadat

resources.string: Have you seen István, my husband? I haven't seen him since the invasion and I'm beginning to worry…

string.direction: Not quite angry, more annoyed.
string.speaker: Lepadat
string.name: Lepadat

resources.string: Thanks. I don't know what I'll do without him. We were minding our business when they attacked us! I don't understand how the shields could have failed.
Could you help board up my windows? It pains me to see so much hard work and effort destroyed by those murderous beasts.
"No, I'll keep an eye out."
Thank you for your help. Though, maybe it is time we moved out of here. I've heard Măr Amar is peaceful -- if not boring. At least its buildings still stand!

string.context: The players will hear this if they managed to make it into the zone before they can do any of the quests.
string.speaker: Voicu
string.name: Voicu

resources.string: You might have heard of me, I'm a hunter of some renown.

string.context: He's being rescued by the player from being held by werebeasts.
string.speaker: Voicu
string.name: Voicu

resources.string: I thought I was going to die when I saw that bearded fellow, but it just turned out to be a Berlaur...

string.context: He's being rescued by the player from being held by werebeasts.
string.speaker: Voicu
string.name: Voicu

resources.string: I'm impressed you got the better of those beasts! There are others captured here you should help. I've heard them, though I haven't seen them.
"The way out is clear."

string.context: The players will hear this if they managed to make it into the zone before they can do any of the quests.
string.speaker: Mierla
string.name: Mierla

resources.string: My grandmother always told me never to pet werewolves! Why didn't I listen?

string.context: She's being rescued by the player from being held by werebeasts.
string.speaker: Mierla
string.name: Mierla

resources.string: You! Please! You've got to let me out of here! I just needed to run my hands through those magnificent manes! That fur! So much fluffiness!

string.context: She's being rescued by the player from being held by werebeasts.
string.speaker: Mierla
string.name: Mierla

resources.string: I owe you my life! I mean I would have died happy anyway, but thanks!
"You can leave now."
I'm sorry to say you've picked a bad time to visit. Well… not that it's ever a good time in Nighthaven…
Your help defending the town has been much appreciated. The shield was supposed to protect Grivaros… it's never failed before.
The Tear of Gaea? Is it truly real? I've only heard whispers -- there is a rumor that Asena has laid claim to it.
The Berlaur are preparing another attack. Help us and perhaps you can hunt down Asena. I am sure she is not far from the battlefield.
"Could the Tear have caused this?"
Welcome to the Grand Carnival! Prepare to be entertained!
Here in Nighthaven, where the old magics were born, we use these potions of Fool's Sight to see the Arcana with our very own eyes.
Time is of the essence, and unfortunately there are more ingredients we need... if we are to truly help Morgaine.
I do not wish to rush you, my friend. However, Morgaine is getting worse. She is not responding to our normal course of medicine. I fear we may be running out of time…
That might be enough for a partial cure… there is only one way to find out. Go to the old Lightshield station and mix the potion with what you have on hand.
"I've only got half the items."
Time is of the essence, and unfortunately there are more ingredients we need... if we are to truly help Morgaine.
Imagine meeting you here! We keep running into each other at the worst places.
The name of the Archive has changed over time. Perhaps too many people knew of it, and the many secrets it guards. What have you discovered?
Oh! Are you trapped in here too? I haven't manged to climb out yet, and I'm terrible at swimming.
Those Berlaur sure were unexpected! They took me by surprise, but I was able to hide here.
Climbing seems to be the only way. Unfortunately, I can't seem to get the hang of these springboards.
Maybe you'll have better luck?
"How do we get out of here?"
If you do get out, could you let Lepădat know where I am? I'm sure he's worrying.
"Nice weather we're having."
She says they can figure out more by investigating the place where it was originally taken from, the destroyed caravan.
Complete the Quest
"When did you last have the Tear?"
In Nighthaven. After you helped procure the Tear from Adiana, or should I say Artemis, my plan was to take it somewhere safe. A place from long ago.
There's an archive in Nighthaven where it could be kept away from pickpockets and prying eyes. But on my way there, it was stolen! I must get it back.
You aren't waiting for me to row us over, are you? Get to the boat, we're going to Nighthaven!
Complete the Quest
I'm impressed we survived the crossing, those waves did me no favors. It's not easy to get to Nighthaven. The people who live here value their privacy.
"Are you feeling alright?"
No, it must have been the journey here. Merely a touch of seasickness, nothing you should worry about.
Instead of me, focus on recovering the Tear of Gaea! You should ask some of the townsfolk about it. They must have seen something.
Oh, my head. I'm not in the mood for talking to people, you'll have to ask any questions about the Tear.
Complete the Quest
We are fortunate to have crossed your path! The town surely would have fallen without your aid.
"Is anyone looking for them?"
Yes. I didn't travel here alone. My master is in the woods, leading the search for anyone missing.
With any luck he's also got the shield up and running. You should find him and see if you can help.
Believe me, if I tried to get the townsfolk to return, they'd just flee farther away.
Complete the Quest
Excellent work! The batteries are recharged and ready for service. But there is yet more to be done if we are to restore power to the shield…
"So the wires are next?"
Yes, installing the batteries must be our first priority. We will turn our attention to the rest of the manor -- and the vermin inside -- in due time.
You must restore power to the shield. Be on your way, now. Time is of the essence.
Complete the Quest
Very impressive! I admit, I thought those flea-infested canids might have gotten the better of you, but you are quite capable, aren't you?
"Did the Berlaur take the Tear?"
I have yet to find out, but only fools rush to battle when caution is the better play. Clearly those beasts had a plan. We must develop our own.
"First we need a way across."
Indeed we do. Before we search for the Tear of Gaea, we will need a way back to the mainland. There must be some path that remains…
Let's adjourn to my castle. Once there, we will have all resources at our disposal. A shame the Berlaur were so clever, destroying the bridge to delay our pursuit.
This is where we part, as it will be faster for each of us to find our own way across. I shall meet you at the castle gates. Good hunting.
Lynette and I shall search east. Let us reconvene later at my castle to discuss the Tear of Gaea and make our plans.
"I'll take the west side."
With the bridge in shambles, we will need to find another path to the mainland.
Complete the Quest
Welcome to our humble camp! It is our pleasure to share it with you. After all, if it wasn't for you, we wouldn't have such a bounty to share amongst ourselves!
"I have been careful."
It is one thing to be careful, but it is another thing entirely to see that which is hidden before you.
You should speak with the Fortune Mother. She wishes to give you a gift, so that your eyes see the truth hidden in the shadows of this land.
But you wish for a cure, not my rambling. The best person to speak to would be the Fortune Mother, for if anyone can recognize Morgaine's symptoms, it would be her.
Go, talk to the Fortune Mother. She has the wisdom you seek.
Complete the Quest
I knew there was something special about you! This new ability you have, Fool's Sight, has a variety of uses, as you'll come to discover.
"What else can it do?"
You'll be able to use your new ability to open doors, unlock new paths, or even challenge mighty foes. It changes how you move through the world.
Speaking of potions, you found your first Arcana card! To fully harness their power, you'll need to craft a potion of Arcana Attunement.
You already have the silver, next you'll need Blue Vervain Buds. Collect them and meet me at the abandoned town up ahead. There I’ll teach you the recipe.
You are a good friend to Morgaine. She needs that, more than she knows.
Complete the Quest
Now that you have forged a connection with one of the Arcana, your Fool's Sight is strong enough to allow you to enter the sealed towers.
"Are any nearby?"
There's a sealed tower across the stream you can use to test the strength of your new abilities. You'll need to understand them to face what lies ahead.
With your new connections to the Arcana, you should be able to break the guardian seals around the tower and defeat the champion inside.
Gather the Ethereal Essence from the chest at the top of the tower and bring it back. This will be a worthy test to prove your mastery of the Arcana.
The time has come to test your proficiency with the Fool's Sight. Good luck, my friend!
Complete the Quest
Bah! I can't believe you wasted such time on these minor folk magics. There are more urgent matters at hand. We must find Asena and reclaim the Tear of Gaea!
"Alecksi invited us to his castle."
Yes, and it is high time we took him up on his offer. Enough gadding about the wilderness, we should go at once!
We need to talk to Alecksi to learn more about the Tear of Gaea.
Complete the Quest
I see your conversations were successful. I promised you information on the Tear of Gaea, and I do not go back on my promises.
"You didn't mention you are King."
Did I not? My apologies, we were so busy in Grivaros, it must have slipped my mind. Forgive my lack of manners, friend. It is merely a title.
Finding the Tear of Gaea is of utmost importance! Do not let me down! My… friend.
Complete the Quest
Thank you for releasing me. To think, Morgaine took the Tear and ran off like that.
"Does that mean your father is...?"
Yes. Alecksi the Warrior King is my father. But enough about him. We need to figure out why Morgaine was after the Tear of Gaea.
"She said it was making her ill."
We must know why. We'll know more by investigating the place where the Tear was being kept. Her camp is not far from here, we'll search there.
We need to go back to the start of this all, where the Tear was first stolen.
Complete the Quest
You found these notes from Morgaine? Let me look… How peculiar. This doesn't make sense, unless…
"Yes. All of those."
It's as I suspected. Your friend has been Enthralled -- soulbound to the service of an Upyr lord. And since my father is after the Tear of Gaea…
Why would he send us both after the Tear if he knew -- we should return to the castle at once! I must confront my father for an explanation.
Leave my father to me. For now, return to the castle and wait for my word.
Complete the Quest
My head is still spinning. To think that my own father planned to sacrifice my life to bring my mother back… How can such a thought be true?
"We need to find Morgaine."
She may know more about Alecksi's plans than even us. However, if she has been Enthralled, she will be loyal only to her new lord. We should tread carefully.
I doubt he would keep her in plain sight. No, I suspect he'd hide her somewhere. He sometimes offers his Thralls to House Bathory as… favors.
We need to find Morgaine and question her about the Tear… and my father.
Complete the Quest
We were led astray! She was never here! This was just a diversion to prevent us from stopping her…
"I hope it's not too late."
I hope so too. We must hurry if we want to reach her before the Gift takes its hold.
We must show her that these petty nobles are merely using her. They are playing her false; she still has a choice!
We need to reach Morgaine before she finishes her transformation!
Complete the Quest
The Enthrallment isn't complete, but it might as well be. I fear there is little we can do for her now.
"There must be a way."
Well… there are rumors. About miracles performed by the Grand Carnival. Their magic is said to be far older, and works in mysterious ways.
"I have friends at the Carnival."
Then you should go, quickly, before the Upyr realize that Morgaine has slipped their grasp. Use one of the carriages from Carmilla -- you can travel safely that way.
I doubt I'd be welcome there, but I have some things to investigate myself. I'll meet up with you later.
Go! You must make it to the Grand Carnival before my father realizes what we have done.
Complete the Quest
It is good you arrived when you did, there is still time for your friend.
"Do you know where the Archive is?"
Ah, the lost Archive. I have not thought about that place in a long time. The Archive is vast, ancient, and unforgiving. Only enter when you know what you seek.
Those who enter the Archive without a purpose will wander endlessly and never find the way out. Seek the entrance at the Ruins of the Kings. They will be your eyes.
Start your search at the Ruins of the Kings. There you will find a guide for the lost Archive.
Complete the Quest
While you were searching below, I found a few bits of information tucked away in the upper ruin. I fear we must visit a place I have avoided for many years.
"We have the Amulet of Ninsun."
Yes. And with the amulet, a way to fight back! We must go to Lilith and use it to enter her dreams -- and stop my father from destroying Aeternum.
We must reach Lilith before my father!
Complete the Quest
Thank you. It was not easy to stand against my father, but I see now he was willing to trade the entire world for one person.
"At least no one else can use it."
Yes. The Tear is where it should be, out of reach -- and out of danger. I will do the same with the Amulet of Ninsun. May it never fall into the wrong hands.
"What happens now?"
I will lock this chamber so none can enter here again. Meet me back in my mother's chapel -- the place where we first met.
I must think on what I will do next. Go on ahead. I will meet you in the chapel.
Complete the Quest
With my father gone, I am heir to the throne. My father ruled the night, and my mother, light. I will bring the best of them both and usher in a new dawn for Nighthaven.
"But the Tear of Gaea is gone…"
It is... yes. The loss of the Tear does not bode well, and I'm not sure if anyone knows what that means for Nighthaven. For all of Aeternum, really.
I do not know what the future holds, but you have given me the courage to embark on this journey. I am forever in your debt. Thank you, Soulwarden.
"Who would know the truth?"
I shudder at the thought, but perhaps Carmilla would know. Secrets are her favorite currency, and there are none wealthier.
"We'll find her."
For your sake, I hope so. But when her transformation is complete, she will no longer be your ally.
Have you found where Morgaine is being held yet? We can't waste any more time.
Complete the Quest
The tower must be where they are hiding her. This might be our last chance to save your friend.
"What must I do to help her?"
I require four heirlooms to reverse Morgaine's condition. The Lightshield Crusade once held them in their possession. How I miss them; they were a beacon of light in dark times.
I have no love for the cruel Inquisitors that inhabit the old Lightshield fortresses. Take from them what you must -- in order to save your friend.
"How can I find them?"
Search the old fortresses for the heirlooms we require, but do not forget: you have the Fool's Sight! Trust it to guide your path.
Morgaine is counting on you. Without your help, I'm not sure she will resist the Upyr curse.
Complete the Quest
Very good. I hope this will be enough to prevent Morgaine's condition from getting worse. We must bring it to the Fortune Mother at once!
"I'll do what I have to."
This will be faster if we split up. I will take the reduction back to the Fortune Mother. Meanwhile, I think you have the more dangerous task…
We need some reagents that are only found within the dens of the Spider Queen, Uttu. This won't be easy, my friend.
We must move fast if we are to save Morgaine.
Complete the Quest
Ah, you acquired the reagents. I will do my best to keep the curse from claiming your friend, but I'm afraid the rest will be up to her.
"Do you think she'll recover?"
Morgaine was selected by Alecksi for a reason. She is strong in Mind and Spirit, and there is no questioning her determination. I suspect she will pull through.
"Can I see her?"
I would caution against that. She is being hunted by the Upyr now, and it is best if she remains alone. She will seek you out when she is ready.
"I found the Keystone."
Then there is hope yet. The Keystone is the way into the Archive. I doubt my father ever thought we'd be tenacious enough to find it.
I seem to remember something from my mother's journal about a special artifact in the Archive. I'll search for the page, then meet you on the other side of the bridge.
We'll meet again at the Archive. Good luck crossing the bridge.
Complete the Quest
That ambush was an act of desperation. Just like with Morgaine, he seeks to delay us. But no more. We will put an end to his plan.
